requirement:
> `Close a delivered search and record dependencies for snippets you used to
> justify your conclusion without an additional source read. search_id is the
> result's UUID and used is an array of its short entry tags, e.g.
> {"search_id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111","used":["1"]}. Entries
> whose source you also read may be omitted; including them is harmless. Use
> used:[] when no entries qualify, including an empty search. Every delivered
> search must be finished before submission. The result is {search_id,
> finished:true}; no additional source is delivered.`
rationale:
The requirement fixes the exact `description` text of the `finish_search` MCP tool. Its only structural obligation is that the tool definition carries that text.

- **Implementation:** `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/project_sources.rs#impl[Session<'_, D>/ToolSession<D>]/fn[definitions]` builds the `finish_search` definition, and its `description` string matches the required text. I compared it sentence by sentence, from "Close a delivered search…" through "…no additional source is delivered." The escaped JSON example `{"search_id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111","used":["1"]}` is also identical. The function carries the `{impl}` reference to `requirements.sdk.graph.search.finish_search.mcp.description`.
- **Related structure:** the same definition has `search_id` and `used` as required parameters, which fits the description. The description's other claims are behavioral, not structural: that the result is `{search_id, finished:true}`, and that used tags record dependencies. `fn[dispatch]` routes `finish_search` to `pages.finish_search`, and I did not assess it for this requirement.
- **Tests:** no source carries a `{test}` reference to this requirement. The same is true of its sibling `.mcp.description` requirements for `search_text` and `search_structure`. The test `search_obligations_follow_delivery_and_keep_the_original_snapshot` checks the `finish_search` parameter schema but not the description text. The obligation is a verbatim literal in a single definition, and this assessment is structural, so I do not count the absence of a test as a gap.
- **Acknowledgments:** none are supplied or needed.
